chunks: And as for the right of the Hajj, that you know it is an arrival before your Lord, and a flight to Him from your sins; through it your repentance is accepted and you perform the obligation that God made incumbent upon you.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual significance and right of Hajj in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: Imam Zayn al-Abidin elevates the Hajj from a physical rite to a profound spiritual migration (hijrah) back to the Divine, framing it as the ultimate mechanism for expiating sins and validating one's repentance. This perspective aligns with the Shia emphasis on the inner dimension (batin) of worship, where the ritual serves as a catalyst for spiritual purification and the fulfillment of the covenant with Allah.
